name: Clash Verge status
author: punkmonday
description: Mihomo/Clash Verge core status in the Omarchy bar: live throughput, rule/global/direct mode, TUN switch, proxy-group selection, and a DNS health probe — all read and set through the local mihomo REST API over its unix socket.

barWidget.description: Clash Verge (mihomo) traffic speed, mode, TUN, proxy groups, and DNS health.

schema.label: Status refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often mode, TUN state, and proxy groups are polled from the local mihomo API. Background polling of a fixed local unix socket; no external network use.

schema.label: Traffic sample interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often session byte totals are sampled while the panel is open, to compute live down/up speeds.

schema.label: Probe mihomo DNS health
schema.description: Once a minute, asks the core's own DNS to resolve www.gstatic.com through the API. A broken fake-IP path shows up here instead of as silent 'limited connectivity'.

schema.label: mihomo unix socket path
schema.description: Override the API socket location. Empty auto-detects the Clash Verge service socket (and the core's data-dir socket as a fallback).
